elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 expressly states that Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 limits payment to Services used or ordered during the applicable term.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: The rendered language eliminates the commitment entirely and does not establish a commitment limited to a current 12-month term.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: No commitment or 30-day reduction mechanism appears in the operative language.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Because the commitment is eliminated, the operative language contains no shortfall true-up mechanism or express penalty distinction.
